blocks.text: City of Dreams Manila has been named among the Philippines’ Best Employers 2027, ranking first in the Travel and Leisure category in the fifth edition of the independent study conducted by the Philippine Daily Inquirer and global market research firm Statista. City of Dreams Manila also ranked No. 53 overall among the 300 companies selected. The study drew on more than 700,000 recommendations from a broad sample of employees working at companies with at least 250 employees in the Philippines.
